column1: # Every upstream thing build-seed-image fetches, pinned. upstream_pins.py checks each fetch against this file and
# fails loudly on a mismatch. kind<TAB>name<TAB>pin<TAB>source
#   image:    name = image ref as written in build-seed-image/Dockerfiles, pin = registry manifest digest
#   local:    an image built outside these scripts; pin = docker image Id
#   tarball:  name = file name, pin = sha256 of the file, source = download URL
#   git:      name = checkout, pin = commit, source = repository URL
#   tool:     name = file name, pin = sha256, source = download URL (with {arch} = amd64|arm64)
# Pinned 2026-10-21 from the images and files the 19-server proof was built from.
